authority.note: Registered 2026-08-08 by the abu steward. DIRECTION CHANGE, same day: Gary reviewed the deterministic pixel-port proof sheet (generators/angel-clawd-pixel/proof/contact-sheet.png) and REJECTED that look ('decent job, but I don't really like it'). He wants the mascot generated by an image model (gpt-image-2) as a charming reinterpretation, routed through ABU verbs, with the source screenshot reference/angel-clawd/source/clawd-flag-screenshot.png as the identity ref on every shot. The angel-clawd-pixel generator is SUPERSEDED but kept on disk as history; its outputs are not deliverables, and the rejected hero/detail plates were moved to reference/angel-clawd/superseded-pixel-port/ so the declared sheet slots sit honestly empty until a blessed candidate locks in. The old rectangles-only / computed-never-prompted invariants were replaced with design invariants in the same pass. Nothing locks until Gary blesses a shot: candidates live under candidates/angel-clawd/. Casting sweep run at registration: pip (tin robot), winged-startup (winged block-tower mark), fly-with-claude (conference-hall setting) are each a different thing; no existing entity is this mascot. LOCKED 2026-08-08 on Gary's word 'b and c are wonderful lock them': the default hero is the wings-spread lift (reference/angel-clawd/hero.png) and the wings-raised alt-look is the uplifted-flight variant. Both were regenerated from scratch off the blessed v4d-happy-eyes with the heart and wings lifted, per Gary's instruction to regen rather than shift the existing art. The eyes invariant was amended in the same pass because the blessed form has happy closed eyes and the old invariant still demanded glinted open eyes, which the locked hero would have failed. The detail slot is still null: a crop-zoom of the hero's load-bearing details has not been shot.

structured.sheetsNote: hero and detail are the matrix slots (target paths declared in prompts.md, per the scaffold convention a slot never names a path whose file is not on disk); abu lock-shot fills the path and adds 'hero' to requiredForRender when Gary blesses a candidate from candidates/angel-clawd/. Until then the slots sit null on purpose and status stays unlocked, so the render gate refuses. The identity refs are source photographs, not sheets: reference/angel-clawd/source/clawd-clean-screenshot.png (PRIMARY, Gary 2026-08-08 mid-run, passed first on every shot) and source/clawd-flag-screenshot.png (SECONDARY, flag-accessory variants only, shows how the flag mounts); both carry source-provenance recipes and are wired through prompts.md.

registerNeutral.medium: flat pixel-sticker illustration: a cute designed-sticker take on a pixel mascot, crisp blocky shapes on a solid chroma ground (keyed to transparent for deliverables)
registerNeutral.why: Recorded medium exception to the house ink-and-wash register (see canon/craft/pixel-mascot-medium-exception.json): this is merch-facing mascot art. No register anchor and no register poles are ever passed on its shots; identity comes from the canonical Clawd screenshot in reference/angel-clawd/source/.

invariants: It is recognizably the Anthropic pixel critter: a small coral pixel-critter mascot in the spirit of Claude Code's pixel mascot, with a stepped/blocky silhouette (soft designed-sticker pixel energy is welcome; mushy gradients and full 3D are not).

Two big dark eyes. The BLESSED default (locked 2026-08-08) is happy closed contented eyes: two dark upturned arcs, no glints. Open square eyes each with a single small white glint are the earlier canon form and remain legal for non-merch renditions; the locked hero sheet is the tiebreaker whenever a shot does not say which.
Little dangling legs hanging below the body in flight.
Classic scalloped angel wings growing from BEHIND the body, cream/off-white feathers in scalloped rows; the wings are never held in hands/stubs and never attach in front of the body.

Anthropic coral palette family for the body: #DD775B with shading toward #c05f45 and highlights toward #ea9077; mono renditions use a single burnt orange (#b0512e family) or all-cream/white (#fffdf7 family) for shirt-color flexibility.
Optional accessories only from canon: a halo above the head, a small floating heart beside it, a checkered racing flag held at its side, or none.
Transparent ground on every deliverable: renders are shot on a solid chroma-green field and keyed; no baked background, no cream paper, no drop shadow on the final PNG.

wings-raised.note: WINGS RAISED, the uplifted-flight silhouette. Blessed by Gary 2026-08-08 ('b and c are wonderful lock them') alongside the default. The entity's own lore already declared 'wings spread or raised' as canon, so this fills that second look rather than opening a new axis. Both looks came from one regeneration pass over the blessed v4d-happy-eyes: same body, same halo position, wings lifted so they spread from high on the body with the tips above the head line, and the floating heart raised level with the halo. Halo and body do NOT move between the two looks; only the wings and the heart do.
negatives: wings drooping level with or below the shoulders (that is the default look, not this one)
wings changed in size, shape or feather count
the halo or body shifted to follow the wings

relativeTo.clawd: identical size to (same critter, with wings)

prose.voice: Silent. It hovers, it glints, it loves.
prose.lore: Adapted from the TastefulStories.com cooking-screen Clawd (tastefulstories/src/app/story/Clawd.tsx), itself a tiny rectangle-built critter in the spirit of Claude Code's pixel mascot. The PRIMARY identity reference is Gary's clean screenshot of the canonical pixel Clawd (reference/angel-clawd/source/clawd-clean-screenshot.png, supplied mid-run 2026-08-08, replacing the flag screenshot as primary), passed as the first input image on every shot; the flag screenshot (source/clawd-flag-screenshot.png) is a secondary ref for flag-accessory variants only, showing how the flag mounts. This angel form is Anthropic-fan-art for Gary's personal evangelism merch: the 'Anthropic Mom' / 'Proud Mom - An Anthropic Evangelist' print-on-demand shirts (burnt orange + white). Accessories in canon: the floating pixel heart, a halo, a checkered flag, or none; wings spread or raised.
prose.rules: DELIBERATE REGISTER EXCEPTION: this universe's register is warm-editorial ink-and-wash and this entity is flat pixel-sticker mascot art on purpose; see canon/craft/pixel-mascot-medium-exception.json and structured.registerNeutral. Never pass the register anchor or its rejected poles when producing this motif, and never restyle it into ink-and-wash. Production path since 2026-08-08: gpt-image-2 via the framework provider adapter, source screenshot passed first as the identity ref, greenscreen ground keyed with the framework chroma keyer. The deterministic generator angel-clawd-pixel is SUPERSEDED history, not the production path. If the mascot must appear INSIDE a model-rendered ink-and-wash scene, that is a new decision requiring Gary's blessing, not a default.
